edges.effect_quant: Pooled meta-analytic evidence do not show a stable clinically large signal for this edge.
edges.mechanism: Selenium is plausibly linked to Prostate cancer through mechanisms that fit its exposure class and target tissue, but the exact pathway depends on dose, timing, and baseline vulnerability. The best interpretation is usually that it changes the biologic setting in which Prostate cancer develops rather than acting as a single on-off switch.
edges.summary: Pooled meta-analytic evidence link selenium to little consistent change in prostate cancer in adult men. The average effect is usually trivial rather than dramatic, so this edge is better read as a risk modifier than a stand-alone cause or cure.
edges.caveats: Dose, timing, and baseline risk still matter. Observational edges may partly reflect broader lifestyle patterning, while small trials can overstate benefit if follow-up is short.
